recovery: The original ephemeral precision outputs were unavailable after interruption. This is a new exact-source/input rerun with separate provenance and periodic local checkpoint preservation.

protocol.reward_change: Linear velocity exponential reward std changes from sqrt(0.1) to0.08. Reward includes XY velocity error plus vertical-body-velocity squared; this is not a pure XY-only intervention.
protocol.stop_definition: <=0.02m/s planar speed and <=0.05rad/s yaw continuously for0.5s, both endpoint samples included. Engineering measurement definition only; resets are censored failures.

limitations: One training seed per arm; three evaluation seeds vary startup physical randomization and observation noise, not independently trained policies.
Continuous correlated time samples and seeded worlds do not establish a hardware failure probability.
Reported segment velocity/effort metrics exclude warmup and reset-invalid samples; configured failures/timeouts are counted separately across the whole segment.
The standing pre-stop and motion state differ between arms; stopping results must be read with achieved moving velocity, not alone.
Torso signed-distance geometry covers compiled model plane contact; lower-leg geometry and actual robot dimensions remain separate limits.
Zero observed configured failure terminations is not a claim that every possible fall/contact/instability is detected.
decision: Retain both as unpromoted experiment artifacts. Precision improves translation substantially but worsens yaw, effort/slip and stop distance, and both request large target changes. Neither is installed as the Spider walking foundation.
causal_findings: Largest native controller-target jumps occur when a nonzero command is first applied:1.094rad baseline/1.208rad precision, after completed activation. The gait-reference offset changes by0.544rad at that edge.

Large changes also occur during sustained commands at uniform52Hz: backward targetstep1.020rad baseline/1.061rad precision while the reference changes only0.088rad. This excludes activation anchoring or a large timing gap as the sole cause.

GPU50Hz rollouts independently contain1.69–2.06rad target changes after warmup within one constant commanded segment and episode. The behavior is already present under the training simulator control contract.
Actual C++RTNeural outputs on512captured960-dimensional inputs match the exported NumPy actor within1.95e-6. Baseline read-only instrumentation preserves its previous trajectory exactly.
Earlier corrected5498 full-hull/class-driver native replay already had1.271rad targetsteps and20.13rad/s maximum joint speed; the problem predates these continuations.

Both arms settle on384/384bounded stop trials with no resets, but precision starts from faster achieved movement and takes longer/farther to stop. A slow policy does not earn a capability claim merely by stopping quickly.
next_experiment: Add an opt-in command-target slew contract in both training and deployment, initialized from the measured/clipped target at reset/activation, after controller/driver position limits and before latency, preserving raw action history. Evaluate matched continuations and command/stop/effort/geometry metrics before any promotion.15rad/s is an engineering command bound, not a measured motor limit.
